59: func appendPbmMetric(metrics *[]prometheus.Metric, name, help string, value float64, labels map[string]string) {
60: 	const prefix = "mongodb_pbm_"
61: 	d := prometheus.NewDesc(prefix+name, help, nil, labels)
62: 	*metrics = append(*metrics, prometheus.MustNewConstMetric(d, prometheus.GaugeValue, value))
63: }

65: func (p *pbmCollector) collect(ch chan<- prometheus.Metric) {
66: 	defer measureCollectTime(ch, "mongodb", "pbm")()
67: 
68: 	var metrics []prometheus.Metric
69: 	logger := p.base.logger
70: 
71: 	pbmClient, err := sdk.NewClient(p.ctx, p.mongoURI)
72: 	if err != nil {
73: 		logger.Errorf("failed to create PBM client: %s", err.Error())
74: 		return
75: 	}
76: 
77: 	pbmConfig, err := pbmClient.GetConfig(p.ctx)
78: 	if err != nil {
79: 		logger.Errorf("failed to get PBM configuration: %s", err.Error())
80: 		return
81: 	}
82: 
83: 	if pbmConfig != nil {
84: 		appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "cluster_backup_configured",
85: 			"PBM backups are configured for the cluster",
86: 			float64(1), nil)
87: 
88: 		if pbmConfig.PITR.Enabled {
89: 			appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "cluster_pitr_backup_enabled",
90: 				"PBM PITR backups are enabled for the cluster",
91: 				float64(1), nil)
92: 		}
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	metrics = append(metrics, pbmBackupsMetrics(p.ctx, pbmClient, logger)...)
96: 	metrics = append(metrics, p.pbmAgentMetrics(p.ctx, pbmClient, logger)...)
97: 
98: 	for _, metric := range metrics {
99: 		ch <- metric
100: 	}
101: }

103: func (p *pbmCollector) pbmAgentMetrics(ctx context.Context, pbmClient *sdk.Client, l *logrus.Entry) []prometheus.Metric {
104: 	clusterStatus, err := cli.ClusterStatus(ctx, pbmClient, cli.RSConfGetter(p.mongoURI))
105: 	if err != nil {
106: 		l.Errorf("failed to get cluster status: %s", err.Error())
107: 		return nil
108: 	}
109: 
110: 	metrics := make([]prometheus.Metric, 0, len(clusterStatus))
111: 
112: 	for replsetName, nodes := range clusterStatus {
113: 		for _, node := range nodes {
114: 			switch {
115: 			case node.OK:
116: 				appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "agent_status",
117: 					"PBM Agent Status",
118: 					float64(pbmAgentStatusOK),
119: 					map[string]string{
120: 						"host":        node.Host,
121: 						"replica_set": replsetName,
122: 						"role":        string(node.Role),
123: 					})
124: 
125: 			case node.IsAgentLost():
126: 				appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "agent_status",
127: 					"PBM Agent Status",
128: 					float64(pbmAgentStatusLost),
129: 					map[string]string{
130: 						"host":        node.Host,
131: 						"replica_set": replsetName,
132: 						"role":        string(node.Role),
133: 					})
134: 
135: 			default: // !node.OK
136: 				appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "agent_status",
137: 					"PBM Agent Status",
138: 					float64(pbmAgentStatusError),
139: 					map[string]string{
140: 						"host":        node.Host,
141: 						"replica_set": replsetName,
142: 						"role":        string(node.Role),
143: 					})
144: 			}
145: 		}
146: 	}
147: 
148: 	return metrics
149: }

151: func pbmBackupsMetrics(ctx context.Context, pbmClient *sdk.Client, l *logrus.Entry) []prometheus.Metric {
152: 	backupsList, err := pbmClient.GetAllBackups(ctx)
153: 	if err != nil {
154: 		l.Errorf("failed to get PBM backup list: %s", err.Error())
155: 		return nil
156: 	}
157: 
158: 	metrics := make([]prometheus.Metric, 0, len(backupsList))
159: 
160: 	for _, backup := range backupsList {
161: 		appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "backup_size",
162: 			"Size of PBM backup",
163: 			float64(backup.Size), map[string]string{
164: 				"opid":   backup.OPID,
165: 				"status": string(backup.Status),
166: 				"name":   backup.Name,
167: 			})
168: 
169: 		var endTime int64
170: 		switch backup.Status { //nolint:exhaustive
171: 		case defs.StatusDone, defs.StatusCancelled, defs.StatusError, defs.StatusDown:
172: 			endTime = backup.LastTransitionTS
173: 		default:
174: 			endTime = time.Now().Unix()
175: 		}
176: 
177: 		duration := time.Unix(endTime-backup.StartTS, 0).Unix()
178: 		appendPbmMetric(&metrics, "backup_duration_seconds",
179: 			"Duration of PBM backup",
180: 			float64(duration), map[string]string{
181: 				"opid":   backup.OPID,
182: 				"status": string(backup.Status),
183: 				"name":   backup.Name,
184: 			})
185: 	}
186: 	return metrics
187: }
